Shelly Groisman
Okay. Let's get started. So, hi, everyone, and thank you for joining the Maris-Tech Investor Webinar. I'm Shelly Groisman, the Marketing Manager of Maris-Tech. Today, our CEO, Israel Bar, and our CFO, Nir Bussy, will present the latest update for Maris-Tech.
So, Israel, the stage is yours.
Israel Bar
Founder, CEO, President & Director
Hello, everybody, and thank you for your time.
We'll go through a presentation showing Maris's business and technologies. After that, Nir, our CFO, will continue with the financial information. Please take a few seconds to review the legal disclaimer.
So, here is a brief overview of the company. Maris was founded in 2008 and started its operation in 2010. We took the company public in 2022, and we have offices in Israel and the U.S.A.
In Israel, of course, we have the headquarters, the R&D, and manufacturing, and we employ 16 employees. We can say that we have about 20 people working consistently in the company. We have a few freelancers. So everything I'm going to tell you about and all the achievements and the technology development was created by these 16 up to 20 people.
What we are doing in Maris we are dealing with edge computing solutions. We develop hardware and software OEM solutions or final products, which are integrated into remote platforms. And when I'm talking about remote platforms, I'm talking about drones, robots, armored vehicles, and any platform that is carrying sensors, video, audio, and telemetry.
And the platforms that we are providing are dealing with the capture of the information, the transfer, the stream of the information to the operators and integrating AI capabilities on the platforms, although we are not developing AI algorithms by ourselves, but we are providing, I would call it, miniature, low-power light computers either on OEM level or within enclosures, which are serving both pipelines.
Everything related to the video is done by our firmware, and we provide a platform that enables our customers to develop their own AI algorithms, although in certain cases, we are using off-the-shelf tools, as I'm going to describe later on.
In terms of markets and applications, we are dealing with a variety of markets. The main market, as discussed later, is the defense market, homeland security, unmanned vehicles, intelligence gathering, aerospace, and smart city.
Although I'm not going to discuss the aerospace later on, I can emphasize that we have been involved in some spacecraft applications, the Israeli satellite that was launched to the moon, and we have a cooperation with a space company in the U.S.
In terms of customers and partners, we have a long list of customers. I can emphasize the customers, which are the Israeli defense industries like Rafael, IAI, Elbit, and Elta, which are not listed here, the Ministry of Defense, the IDF, and other customers in Israel.
We have partners. Our main partner when it comes to AI is Hailo, an Israeli company that is providing excellent low-power AI accelerators. We have customers worldwide. We are working with Leonardo and other customers.
We have a relationship in partnership with Renesas, a giant Japanese company providing video solutions, and Lightpath, a U.S. company providing thermal cameras, with which we are going to design mutual products.
A few highlights on 2024. First of all, we can say very clearly that Maris became a defense industry. That's clear. It happened at the end of 2023. And during 2024, our main activities are related to the defense market due to the circumstances here in Israel, worldwide, and the fact that the world is now trying to get more defense technology, more defense solutions.
And Maris has the right technology at the right time. And we can see strong revenue generation during 2024 coming from this market. We have created a strategic partnership, and we have launched new products, which are answering the requirements from the market. We have a lot of insightful information about what the market is looking for, and we are developing our products accordingly.
The worldwide edge computing market is growing rapidly. In modern warfare, we clearly see that drones, robots, and other technologies are used on the battlefield. The Maris solutions are now deeply deployed and used in the battlefield, and the opportunities are just growing, and the market is increasing significantly.
In terms of our core business strategy, we will discuss that later on, but we are moving towards final solutions, and we are leveraging our strategic partnerships with other partners worldwide. We are aiming now mainly at the U.S. and the Indian market.
We continue our activities in order to bring unique edge computer solutions and increase their performance and answer new requirements coming from the market.
So I would say that Maris is now becoming a leader, a real leader when it comes to edge computing solutions and especially when it comes to miniature low-power solutions. Just a few words about the financial results, although Nir will go into details, but we had a revenue growth of 50% this year, and we have decreased our loss by 54%.
Let's continue with some other details. When it comes to the worldwide presence, we have increased our presence in the world. Israel, although it is the main market. We are here. We are responding to the market requirements. But we have a lot of activities in Western Europe, in the U.K. based on the relationship we have with a distributor in U.K.
We have activities in every location where we have a flag, but we are going to emphasize during 2025 in markets such as North America, for sure, Eastern Europe, India, and some other markets where we feel there is a need and clear demand for the technology.
We have made a few announcements during this year. I won't go through all of them. I'm sure that you are familiar with the announcements. But I would like to mention some of them, which are key announcements.
In January and April, we made 2 announcements related to intelligence gathering. I can tell you in general that we have been selected by intelligence agencies to develop unique and very powerful intelligence-gathering solutions.
We have been dealing a lot with situation awareness during February '21, June 10, and 1st of August, and we have received big orders for situation awareness platforms, which have been deployed in the battlefield during the last 12 months successfully and saving lives on a daily basis.
We have developed a unique solution, and we announced in June a new order, which is related to a unique solution for a drone video payload with unique capabilities and an important order coming from the U.S. $1 million order based on what we call the Ametis 5G.
It's a platform that supports video streaming over 5G, not narrow band; 5G is not, but the streams are in a narrow band, and this is a real penetration in the U.S. market.
So, let's discuss typical applications. What we can see here are, I would say, the 4 typical applications that we are involved with. One of them is the drone scenario. Maris is already mounted on thousands of drones worldwide in Israel, Europe, India, and some other locations.
And on the drone, we are providing everything necessary to serve surveillance applications, target tracking, and loitering munition. We are becoming the main computing platform on the drone, which communicates with the sensors, with the autopilot, with the radio communication, and with many other capabilities.
Another important application is situation awareness. When we are talking about situation awareness, it can be a solution for a site. However, during this year, we have provided solutions mainly for armored vehicles. I can say that we have equipped our technology on more than 1,000 tanks. I believe this is one of the biggest deployments of a situation awareness platform coming from a single company.
And what we are doing, we enable threat detection based on cameras mounted on the armored vehicle, detecting the threats coming close to the tank either 360 or 3-dimensional. And we are alerting about these threats and saving lives, I would say, this very moment.
Intelligence gathering: I've already mentioned that in intelligence gathering, we enable from remote platforms to collect information and send it over narrowband communication based on AI capabilities so we can detect important information and send it whenever necessary.
We are also providing tactical devices for special operation forces here in Israel and worldwide. What is our strategy for 2025 and for the near future? First of all, we intend, and as a matter of fact, we already started to provide final products. When we're talking about final products, we are talking about a platform within an enclosure, which serves certain applications.
As of today, we have solutions for armored vehicles and missile launches, but we intend to provide some other solutions, which will be described later on. And, of course, this will have an influence on margins and the opportunities in the market.
We see a clear demand for miniature low-power solutions for miniature drones. You cannot imagine how big the drone market is becoming. For example, in Ukraine, they are producing hundreds of thousands of miniature drones yearly, which will need video capabilities, streaming capabilities, and maybe other edge computing capabilities.
And we have created solutions. For example, if you look on the right side corner, the [indiscernible]. This is a platform that we have designed, which is consuming very low power and serving miniature drone applications. And I can tell you that we have a specific customer that is using this technology and collecting information for intelligence gathering.
Tactical devices: We are developing some wearable and miniature and lightweight solutions, which will be used by special operation forces. We will also provide products through a strategic partnership worldwide, which will promote our solutions, either OEM solutions or final products.
We have, I would say, hundreds of different platforms, but they can be divided into certain groups, which are based on the main processor that we are using. I won't go into technology details, but I can tell you that we have 4 family products: the Jupiter, the Mars, the Uranus, and the Venus.
The Uranus is serving the situation awareness, Jupiter is serving intelligence gathering and drones applications, the Mars as well, and the Venus is more related FPGA-based serving some other applications, which are more heavy in terms of video functionality.
Our road map will focus this year on final products. First of all, the integration of the Maris solution with thermal cameras together with our partner in the U.S. Top will be a unique small miniature low-power solution, which will integrate the thermal camera, the Maris video solution together with the Hailo AI capabilities. And we will create a product that doesn't exist, which will be a thermal IP AI-based camera.
The Diamond Ultra is based on the final product that we have designed for armored vehicles, and we will also integrate drone detections and UAV detections on the platform. And the last one, the [peridol], is going to be a unique passive radar, combining a few cameras and creating a sort of AI-based detection solution, which will be passive, not active as a regular radar.
This will include the cameras and the enclosure solution, which can be used for border control and the protection of some other areas. So this is our road map for next year.
And now I will give the stage to Nir to continue with the financial information.
Nir Bussy
Chief Financial Officer
Hi, everyone. My name is Nir, and I'm the CFO of the company. In the following slide, I will share with you some highlights from our financials, focusing on what we can disclose as a public company.
Our revenues continue to grow, increasing from $1 million in 2020 to approximately $6.1 million in 2024, representing a growth of more than 50% in our revenues compared to 2023. Our backlog as of the end of March this year was approximately $9.9 million, which we expect to recognize as revenue in the coming years.
Alongside the growth of our revenues, our net loss continued to decrease from $3.7 million in 2022 to $2.7 million net loss in 2023 and to $1.2 million in 2024. It's representing a decrease in our net loss of more than 54% compared to 2023.
Our cash and cash equivalent as of the end of December last year was approximately $2.3 million. We believe that our cash flow, together with proceeds from our customers and using our line of credit, will be sufficient for us to support our growth and operation in the coming 12 months. Thank you.
Israel Bar
Founder, CEO, President & Director
Okay. Thank you, Nir. And just to summarize what has been discussed, we have discussed our leadership in the defense and homeland security market.
We have discussed the expanding market opportunity, our core business strategy, our position as a supplier of video and edge computing solutions, and the financial highlights described by Nir. We are now open to any questions from the attendees.
Just a second, please. I'm going to answer a question which is related to our agreement with the Indian distributor. The question is that there is limited information available about Swish car technology, which probably contributed to the drop in Maris stock yesterday.
I can tell you that we have signed an agreement with a distributor, which is dealing a lot with the defense market. We believe that this distributor will open some opportunities for us in the market. And we have just started, and I don't see any relation between this agreement and the share price.
Nir Bussy
Chief Financial Officer
We have another question regarding the decrease in revenue between the second half of 2023 and the first half of 2024.
At this stage, we are still a project company with a set of different orders from our customers. Our revenues are not linear through the year. We want it to be linear, but this stage is not linear. For this reason, there will sometimes be a decrease in revenues between different periods. This is the answer to this. And regarding future expectation, there is another question about it, our forecast. This is not public information that we can share at this stage.
Israel Bar
Founder, CEO, President & Director
Okay. Since I don't see any more questions, I would like to thank you all for participating in our webinar, and we will be happy to update you more in the future. Thank you.
